name: shademaker
title: ShadeMaker
caption:
SHADEMAKER

ShadeMaker is a plug-in for Krita that automatically generates a series of shades based on colors provided by the artist. This dramatically speeds up palette-making time; a great convenience for many methods of making 2D art.

It has a variety of features, including different modes for blending in different color spaces and color/value adjustments across shades.

It can be found here ► https://supermethod.gumroad.com/

name: quest_masters_promo
title: Quest Masters
caption:
Quest Masters was an RPG / Management Sim.

Players assmble and customize their own guild of adventurers. Teams of characters are dispatched to various locations where randomly generated adventures await. Strengthen your recruits and find valuable loot to make your guild the most powerful in the world!

Programming, design, and a very small amount of art was provided by me. The vast majority of artwork was provided by Ashleigh Hetrick (https://www.pyawakit.com/).

name: homeworld_celestial_bodies
title: Celestial Bodies
caption:
Homeworld: Vast Reaches needed special systems for drawing deep space scenery.

I created a system that assisted in the placement and rendering of distant objects, like planets. This allowed designers and artists to place elements in space as they please, but conveniently keeps them within camera clip bounds.

The objects are then drawn as if they are appropriately distant from the player.

name: homeworld_lod_debugger
title: LOD Debugger
caption: I created this tool in Unity for debugging LODs & mesh fitness for Homeworld: Vast Reaches. It allows the mesh to be conveniently evaluated visually and provides a variety of useful metrics.

name: homeworld_star_field_gpu_culling
title: Star field GPU Culling
caption:
Homeworld: Vast Reaches needed special systems for drawing deep space scenery.

I created a system that allowed artist to generate a star field which was projected onto a sphere surrounding the player. This sphere was rendered in such a way as to appear extremely distant. This system uses GPU culling to draw as many stars as possible while minimizing performance burden.

I also created tools that allowed artists to “paint” the star system through textures and color gamuts.
